Do not reuse the old inference that red means defective unless OCR or chart_analyzer explicitly grounds that mapping. Preserve earlier grounded facts that the screen includes 70%, 20%, and 10% rows if they remain consistent, but supersede the old semantic interpretation with any newly recovered labels or wording.
